sloka: ताः सर्वा हनुमन् गृह्य क्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि।आश्वासय हरीन् प्राणैर्योज्य गन्धवहात्मज ।। ६.७४.३४ ।।
transliteration: tāḥ sarvā hanuman gṛhya kṣipramāgantumarhasi।āśvāsaya harīn prāṇairyojya gandhavahātmaja ।। 6.74.34 ।।

translations.english: "Hanuman, taking the four herbs you, the son of wind god ought to return immediately with the speed of wind, to unite the life of the monkeys and reassure."
